column1: # Alerts the DAST job does not count (scripts/dast-summary.py reads this file).
# One alert per line: plugin id, tab, reason, tab, date accepted (YYYY-MM-DD).
#   10038<TAB>CSP is set by the proxy in front of the API, checked in the deploy runbook<TAB>2026-12-01
# The plugin id is the number ZAP gives the rule, in the full report in the scan's private folder.
# An accepted id drops every alert from that rule, so name the reason well and review the file
# when a rule's meaning changes. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
